en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a corner building housing a café and wine tavern. The two‑storey house with a tiled gable roof and dormer windows stands on a street corner with an iron fence and small garden terrace where guests are seated. Long painted signs on the facade advertise "Stelzner's Kaffee- u. Wein-Stuben." A hanging sign at the entrance reads "Wein-Stuben Georg Stelzner." The surrounding buildings and streetlamps suggest an early 20th‑century Central European city.
